_comment: Hard CPU/memory ceilings per poker-table entrypoint (issue #567). CI fails if any function exceeds its ceiling. Baselines live in ../gas-budgets.json; ceilings are baseline + headroom and must only be raised with justification. Regenerate guidance: run `cargo test -p poker-table gas_ -- --nocapture` for CPU and `cargo test -p poker-table budget_ceiling -- --nocapture` for live mem, then update this file and scripts/check_soroban_budgets.py report.
_policy: CI fails when measured cpu_insns > cpu_ceiling or mem_bytes > mem_ceiling. Ceilings must stay >= baseline in gas-budgets.json. Lowering a ceiling is always allowed; raising requires a PR note.

create_table.notes: Creates a new table entry in persistent storage. Cost scales with TableConfig size.

join_table.notes: Reads table, appends player, writes back. Includes token transfer.

start_hand.notes: Rotates dealer, posts blinds, transitions to Dealing phase.

commit_deal.notes: Stores hand commitments + deck root. ZK proof verification is mocked in tests.

player_action.notes: Highest variance: Fold can trigger Settlement + pot distribution. Ceiling covers worst case.

reveal_board.notes: Appends board cards, resets betting round. Called 3x per hand (flop/turn/river).

leave_table.notes: Removes player, transfers token balance back. Only allowed in Waiting/Settlement.

claim_timeout.notes: Checks ledger sequence, auto-folds stalling player. May trigger Settlement.

withdraw_rake.notes: Transfers accumulated rake to admin. No-op if rake_balance == 0.

submit_showdown.notes: Six-handed showdown: side pots, rake, payouts and the history archive. ZK proof verification is mocked in tests.
